description: Robot coordination (de-probabilised). Two robots navigate a 2D grid, each with coordinates (x,y), from (0,0) to the far corner (goal,goal). The coalition of both robots brings BOTH to the goal corner despite the adversarial slips -> expected TRUE. Probabilistic move-failure is abstracted as actuator-dominance: a commanded step is +2 and a slip is -1, so a pushing robot nets +1 per axis per round whatever the (unbounded) slips. The goal coordinate is arbitrary (input("env"), not fixed in advance).
